plan.name: Postpartum Return — 2-Week Starter (4 weeks post-c-section cleared for light activity)

goals.name: Safe reconditioning and gradual return to activity
goals.description: Restore general conditioning, pelvic floor awareness, and functional movement while respecting OB clearance: walking and light movement only; no abdominal loading or heavy lifting until 6-week check.

actions.note: If incision pain >3/10, reduce walking duration by 50% and skip gentle_core_bracing; escalate to provider if pain persists.
If energy low, recommend 10–15 minute walk or restorative breathing instead of longer sessions.

activities.name: Diaphragmatic breathing with pelvic floor cue

tracking.notes: Short gentle squeezes (not bearing down). Stop if pain or heaviness.
Gentle transverse activation with exhale; avoid Valsalva and crunching. Stop if any pulling or pain at incision.

checkpoints.name: 2-week check-in
questions: Any new or worsening pain at incision site?
Any urinary or pelvic organ heaviness?
How would you rate overall energy (low/moderate/high)?
